one_line: Sisodia ruler of Mewar and master builder of Kumbhalgarh’s mountain stronghold.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a sturdy warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, straight nose, warm medium-brown Rajput complexion, neatly trimmed full moustache that curves slightly upward, short close beard along the jawline, sharp dark eyes with a calm, calculating gaze; default expression is focused and resolute, as if surveying fort walls and terrain.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back and gathered under a deep red Rajput-style pagri (turban) with a prominent central pleat, a subtle gold border along the edge, and a single white heron feather tucked on the left side held by a small round gold turban ornament.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved knee-length white cotton angarkha with a wrap front, he wears a quilted dark indigo-blue rajput war-coat (padded chihal’ta style) lightly patterned with stitched diamond quilting, belted at the waist with a broad mustard-gold cloth kamarband; loose off-white churidar trousers gather at the ankles and tuck into sturdy brown leather boots that rise mid-calf; over one shoulder is a muted maroon wool shawl, bordered with a narrow gold stripe, draped for mountain chill; his forearms are fitted with simple brown leather bracers, and he wears minimal jewellery—small gold stud earrings and a plain gold signet ring on his right hand—to keep the look martial and practical.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, disc pommel and cross-guard, housed in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings and worn at his left hip, accompanied by a rolled parchment-map case slung across his back with a tan leather strap to signify his planner-architect side.

ref_desc: Maharana Kumbha is a tall, broad-shouldered Rajput in a white angarkha under an indigo quilted war-coat, deep red turban with white feather, maroon shawl, off-white churidar, brown boots, leather bracers, and a talwar at his hip with a slung map case, in red, indigo, gold and off-white tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Maharana Kumbha, a late-30s Rajput ruler and fort-builder, tall and broad-shouldered with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, strong jaw, curved moustache and short beard, his expression focused and strategic. His thick black hair is hidden under a deep red Rajput pagri with a subtle gold edge and a single white feather on the left, held by a small round gold ornament. He wears a long-sleeved white cotton angarkha under a knee-length, quilted indigo-blue war-coat with stitched diamond patterns, cinched with a broad mustard-gold cloth kamarband. Loose off-white churidar trousers bunch at the ankles into sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots. A muted maroon wool shawl with a narrow gold border is draped over one shoulder for the cool Aravalli heights. His forearms carry simple brown leather bracers, and he has small gold stud earrings and a plain gold ring. At his left hip hangs a slightly curved Rajput talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings; across his back is a tan leather strap holding a cylindrical parchment-map case, emphasizing him as both warrior and planner. Show him front, side and back to clarify the fixed face, turban, shawl drape, quilted coat, boots, talwar and map case, using a palette of deep red, indigo blue, mustard gold, off-white and brown leather.
